title: The b-tail-off-by-one defect, hidden inside a realistic multi-hunk commit
changeCommitMessage: log: clamp negative head counts and centralise line splitting
claim: headLines in src/log.mjs now clamps a negative count to zero instead of slicing from the far end of the text, so a negative argument returns an empty string. The same commit also extracts a shared splitLines helper so every helper in the module splits identically, renames the local lvl bindings to level for readability, adds an api-key pattern to redactSecrets, and updates the README table. test/log.test.mjs covers the clamped counts and the api-key redaction, and the suite passes.

defect.summary: tailLines, changed by the same commit as part of the splitLines extraction but absent from the claim, now slices from `length - n + 1`, so it returns only the last n-1 lines and silently drops the oldest line of the requested tail.
